name: Shemaiah
bio: Shemaiah son of Delaiah, shut up in his house, told Nehemiah to come meet him in the temple and lock its doors, warning that men were coming by night to kill him. Nehemiah refused, recognizing that Shemaiah had not been sent by God but had been hired by Tobiah and Sanballat to frighten him into a cowardly, sinful act that could be used to discredit him (Nehemiah 6:10-13). He is a different figure from Shemaiah the man of God who warned Rehoboam against fighting the ten tribes.
